s00593.summary: Teens at the snack bar scramble to hide a stolen trophy from Mrs. Baptiste.
Relieved after the adult passes, the friends laugh and tease Archie.
The adult turns back and Archie panics, shoving the trophy into his hood.
Danger gone, the four collapse into laughter, Archie covered in nacho cheese.

s01231.summary: A shuttered parlour sits dust-sheeted, its clock stopped, a phonograph waiting.
Eveline, veiled in mourning, enters the parlour and notices the phonograph.
She plays the wax cylinder and hears her own young voice swear never to leave.
Calling her younger self a liar, she sits, then restarts the stopped clock.

s01998.summary: In a small courtroom, the judge, defendant, attorney and prosecutor are introduced before sentencing.
Defense and prosecutor talk over each other, trading repayment against the maximum sentence.
Urged by the judge, Seraphina briefly explains her mother's illness and her theft.
Odalys unexpectedly withdraws the State's recommendation and the judge adjourns.

s00352.summary: Henry pushes his widowed mother to sell the store before Friday's deadline.
Henry blurts that Dad is dead; Rose demands he repeat it to her face.
Danny stands, the bucket clatters, and Henry knocks screwdrivers across the floor.
Rose shows the cigar box of cards recording forty years of forgiven customer debts.
Danny refuses to sell and the family agrees to run the store together.

s01517.summary: Three adults sit at children's desks in a nearly abandoned village schoolhouse.
Gwendolen presses about the missing registers and the collapse to eleven pupils.
A small boy arrives asking if this is school; Gwendolen welcomes him as twelfth.

s01832.summary: Six strangers sit to an unwanted meal at a way station; a stranger watches the door.
Stilted talk about weather and a missed stage; Ma Tulliver cuts Sabina off.
Oscar needles the untouched-bowl stranger; Ma Tulliver rises and stands behind his chair.
Jude reaches into his duster and sets a folded letter in the middle of the table.

s01286.summary: The party planner scolds the late clown while the zookeeper warns about the goat.
The goat charges after Gerald pops his balloon sword; everyone chases the chaos.
The goat eats Gerald's wig, the crowd applauds, and Teddy declares best birthday ever.

s02254.summary: Noor hesitates at the base of the ten-meter platform while cousin Felix watches.
Felix jokes about family lore and promises to stay close as she climbs.
Noor reaches the top, Felix covers his eyes, and she laughs and jumps.

s00554.summary: Bakers chisel through an oven tunnel wall on a tight schedule.
Tobias learns the wall leads to the bank vault and protests.
Odile reminds Tobias of their record and wins his trust to hold the lantern.
Odile picks the vault lock in silence while the men wait.
The lock opens; the men laugh in relief and turn to the clock.

s00660.summary: Mags opens a corporate summit in a salt mine to an unamused audience.
A silent stranger calls her pyramid good and cryptically says he is observing.
Tybalt reveals the company was bought last Thursday and the stranger is from corporate.
Raymond identifies himself as Acquisitions and mocks the pyramid's deep pit.
Defeated, Mags sits; Dolores comforts Tybalt and Raymond offers sandwiches.

s00853.summary: A makeshift small claims court sits at the end of a bowling lane.
Elspeth accuses Abernathy of bowling a ball through her window; he quibbles over the time.
The judge jokes about no jury or coffee, and his gavel rolls under the lane.

s00237.summary: Maeve radios a mayday as the trawler floods and help is an hour away.
Ruth takes the radio and announces they will abandon ship in ten minutes.
With the pump dead, Maeve dives into flooded water to retrieve the flare.
On deck the flare fires and a searchlight finds the crew.

s02203.summary: Five operatives sit in a circle under an open observatory dome.
Elspeth warns of an impending leak and checks everyone's devices.
Elspeth proposes feeding each member false stories to trap the leaker.
Oksana and Cecilia leave; Hamza privately asks whom Elspeth suspects.

s00171.summary: Nacho enters a laundromat and sets a ring before his coldly folding sister.
Siblings argue over their dead father and who kept Nacho from his bedside.
Bernadette sweeps the shirts to the floor and Nacho kicks the duffel, losing the ring.

s00184_0.summary: Ruth closes her appeal argument for excluded recorded testimony before the Justice.
A note arrives: the State has withdrawn its opposition and the conviction will be vacated.
A call confirms the real priest verified the story; Ruth exhales.
Ruth gathers her papers and walks out, steady back, unsteady knees.

s01191.summary: Teodora and a real-estate agent tour an abandoned carousel workshop of hanging horses.
A motionless old man paints a wooden horse and ignores the intruders.
Harlan turns, revealing a carved hinged face, and says closing time as the horses turn.

s01986.summary: Leonie exposes laser-etched fake corks on bottles sold as vintage 1982.
Nate, Maximilian and Dorothea blame each other for the forged provenance.
A creak above leads Leonie to take phones; the flashlight dies as footsteps descend.

s02260.summary: Kalinda stretches at the empty pre-dawn track and plays her recorded log.
She runs laps while old audio logs trace her progress; dawn lights the sky.

s01450.summary: Orsolya tends an orchard of glass trees and senses a deeper chime from the roots.
Kaedmon arrives uninvited bearing a satchel and bare dagger.
He produces a black seed that silences the orchard; Orsolya demands where he got it.
He plants the seed, they fight, and a giant root splits the well and ignites the orchard.

s00035.summary: Roz and Dennis are trapped in a freezer, pounding the frozen door.
A stranger in a tuxedo has been there for days and his breath does not fog.
Roz and Dennis smash through the door and escape while Lazarus waves goodbye.

s02041.summary: Barnaby gently teases nervous new assistant Penelope as he introduces the python Gladys.
Penelope watches unflinching as Gladys strikes a mouse; Barnaby is impressed.
Barnaby admits Gladys is missing and the snake is a decoy.
A thump in the vent above makes both freeze as something coils overhead.

s02089.summary: A barn serves as small claims court, with goats, a cowbell and a buzzing crate.
Archie accuses Dorothea's bees of using his clover without paying.
The judge asks what he wants, honey, and settles it with a jar.

s02108.summary: Doctors and nurses race to revive a crashing patient with compressions and epinephrine.
A weak beep returns and the patient has a thready pulse.
Exhausted doctors insist they are fine until Beatriz glares them into sitting.

s00719.summary: The crew races eleven minutes against a critical engine core.
Ravi reports failing aft shields and is ordered to a console.
Ximena and Tuck push the lever together, stabilizing the core.

s00062.summary: Derby skaters lace up before the season's last bout as Horty briefs the nervous rookie.
Bruiser takes Josefina under her wing and the three walk into the lights.
